name: hero
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: landscape product photograph for an ATV cover website, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio.
Input image: the supplied garage photograph is the edit target and factual product reference.
Primary request: isolate the existing black covered ATV and its adjacent black drawstring storage bag on a minimal off-white/light-gray seamless studio floor and background. Remove the garage, all writing, graphic panels, logos, icons, dimension text and overlays. Show the whole covered ATV silhouette and the storage bag with generous breathing room, centered in a landscape composition. Retain the reference camera angle and relative product proportions.
Materials and lighting: realistic black Oxford fabric with the same visible folds, seams, drape and factual construction as the reference; soft neutral studio illumination so black fabric remains black while its folds are readable, and a soft realistic contact shadow under the wheels and bag.
Invariants: preserve the cover's exact recognizable silhouette and drape, its broad uninterrupted construction, the same exposed ATV wheels, and the same simple drawstring storage bag placed adjacent in the foreground. Change the setting and remove advertising graphics only; reconstruct only the small areas obscured by those graphics consistently with adjacent fabric. Do not invent product features.
Avoid: text of any kind, labels, logo, watermark, garage objects, decorative props, silver fabric, added straps, added pockets, mirror sleeves, handles, vents, zippers, new components, dramatic lighting, colored highlights, cropped wheels or bag.

name: alternate
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: alternate landscape product photograph for an ATV cover website, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio.
Input image: the supplied forest photograph of the black covered ATV is the edit target and factual product reference.
Primary request: replace the entire forest, leaves and ground with a minimal off-white/light-gray seamless studio floor and backdrop. Remove all text, icons, graphic panels and overlays. Keep exactly the same covered ATV, same side-three-quarter camera view, orientation and proportions. Center the whole silhouette in a landscape frame with breathing room around every edge.
Materials and lighting: realistic black Oxford fabric; retain its particular reference folds, creases, seams, drape and factual construction, neutrally lit with soft studio illumination and a realistic soft contact shadow beneath the wheels. Black fabric must remain visibly black with readable folds.

Avoid: text, labels, logos, watermarks, forest, leaves, props, storage bag, silver lining, mirror sleeves, invented projections, added straps, vents, pockets, zippers, handles or other new components, glossy plastic look, dramatic colored lighting, cropped product.

name: material
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: landscape macro material photograph for an ATV cover website, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio.
Input image: use ONLY the LEFT HALF showing the black Oxford fabric weave and clear water droplets as the material edit target and factual texture reference. The right-hand silver rival material is excluded completely.
Primary request: create a clean, tasteful macro studio photograph of this same black woven Oxford fabric gently folding on a minimal off-white/light-gray seamless studio surface, with several naturally varied clear water droplets resting on its weave. Preserve the reference's characteristic black woven thread texture and realistic droplet optics. Let the black fabric fill most of the frame while a little light studio backdrop remains visible around it.
Lighting and composition: landscape close-up, gently curved fabric fold, soft neutral studio light revealing the weave without turning the fabric silver; soft realistic shadow where the fabric meets the light surface, calm minimal product photography.
Invariants: the only material is the left-side black Oxford weave. Every visible fabric face and edge stays black, without revealing or implying a different inner lining. No comparison layout and no additional product components.
Avoid: silver or metallic material, silver lining, right-side rival fabric, cutaway, zipper, stitching invented as a feature, bag, ATV, accessories, text, specifications, claims, labels, logos, symbols, watermark, graphics, dramatic colored lighting.
